title: MonsterEngine .monsterlod package.json inventory

files.description: Every regular ZIP file except package.json exactly once; names also unique under ASCII case folding. Includes unchanged binary scene.mgs and all referenced page files.

$comment: Only STORED/DEFLATED, regular files, portable ASCII relative components. No encrypted, ZIP64, multidisk, links, duplicate normalized names, traversal or directory entries. Archive <= 4294967295 bytes, actual expanded <= 16 GiB; metadata admission is 16 MiB and disk reserve 256 MiB. Native validation is mandatory before publication; this JSON does not replace the binary scene protocol.
